data.reasoning: The PKGBUILD is a standard Rust VCS package with no top-level execution, no malicious patches, and no suspicious network calls. The only disagreement stems from an API error in the Qwen model, not a security concern.
data.disagreement_analysis: The Qwen model encountered HTTP 400 BadRequestErrors when auditing LICENSE and .nvchecker.toml, forcing an 'inconclusive' verdict. The Deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit LICENSE and .nvchecker.toml due to API errors.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) to prevent incomplete audits from triggering false 'inconclusive' verdicts.
The file selection logic appears to have queued the LICENSE file twice; deduplication should be applied before sending files to the LLM.
